audience: managers who build and publish team rotas in Merchant360

useCases.title: Check the week's rota and open shifts
useCases.text: List the shifts of a date window with the staff roster. Ask the assistant which shifts still have no worker.

useCases.title: Review pending time-off and shift trade requests
useCases.text: List the staff time-off and shift trade requests, newest first, filtered by status. Ask the assistant to summarize each one.

useCases.title: Approve or deny a staff request with a note
useCases.text: Approve or deny one staff request and add a note. The worker gets a text with the outcome. Approved time off also blocks those days on the public booking calendar.

useCases.title: Draft new shifts and publish the week
useCases.text: Create draft shifts with a role, break and note, or leave the worker empty for an open shift. Publishing texts each scheduled worker who has a mobile number.

useCases.title: Change or delete a shift after publishing
useCases.text: Read one shift, then change its time, worker, role or note, or delete it. Publish again so staff see a change to a published shift.
